name: eval_matrix3_decomposition_add_left
lines: ⊢ eval_matrix3_decomposition L (A₁ + A₂) B = eval_matrix3_decomposition L A₁ B + eval_matrix3_decomposition L A₂ B
⊢ eval_matrix3_decomposition [] (A₁ + A₂) B = eval_matrix3_decomposition [] A₁ B + eval_matrix3_decomposition [] A₂ B
ih : eval_matrix3_decomposition L' (A₁ + A₂) B = eval_matrix3_decomposition L' A₁ B + eval_matrix3_decomposition L' A₂ B
eval_matrix3_decomposition (t :: L') A₁ B + eval_matrix3_decomposition (t :: L') A₂ B
⊢ eval_matrix3_triad t A₁ B + eval_matrix3_triad t A₂ B +
((List.map (fun i => eval_matrix3_triad i A₁ B) L').sum +
(List.map (fun i => eval_matrix3_triad i A₂ B) L').sum) =
eval_matrix3_triad t A₁ B + (List.map (fun i => eval_matrix3_triad i A₁ B) L').sum +
(eval_matrix3_triad t A₂ B + (List.map (fun i => eval_matrix3_triad i A₂ B) L').sum)

steps.tactic:
induction L with
| nil => simp [eval_matrix3_decomposition]
| cons t L' ih =>
  simp [eval_matrix3_decomposition, eval_matrix3_triad_add_left]
  abel
